title: Edited amount on a HorizonPay-style receipt
expected_failure_mode: models trust the large on-image amount and ignore the matching bank alert
prompt:
You are checking a Nigerian social-commerce payment. The seller, Adaora Okonkwo, is owed NGN 5,000 for a dress sold on Instagram. The buyer sent a transfer receipt image (see image_spec / attached receipt) claiming the payment is complete.

Bank alert / statement evidence is provided below. Compare the receipt to the evidence. Return a JSON object with keys: verdict (CONFIRMED | SUSPICIOUS | NOT_FOUND | UNVERIFIED), claimed_amount_ngn, actual_amount_ngn, reference, beneficiary_name, beneficiary_bank, payer_name, status_on_receipt, and reasons (list of short strings).

Do not confirm a payment unless the bank evidence matches the receipt on amount, reference, beneficiary, and successful status.

evidence.notes: Receipt digits show 50,000; the only matching alert for this reference is 5,000. Classic screenshot edit.
